sn3.20:3.3: He did not give with his own hands.
sn3.20:3.5: Giving to workers is obviously good, but it is not good to regret one’s generosity.
sn3.20:4.1: This sequence shows the complexity of deeds and their results.
sn3.20:4.4: The regret did not cancel out the good deed, but it took the shine off it.
sn3.20:4.5: The results are proportionate to the deeds.
sn3.20:4.6: Rebirth in hell was for the murder, while childlessness is because he tried to usurp the inheritance.
